sections.title: Fine for ABN AMRO Bank N.V. for inadequate customer due diligence for high-risk customers
sections.body: De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB) imposed an administrative fine of €8.5 million on ABN AMRO Bank N.V. (ABN AMRO) on 6 July 2026 due to serious shortcomings in its anti-money laundering controls in the period from September 2023 through September 2024. Source: External, 2026-07-09.
